name: Potentiostat / galvanostat
purpose: Electrode EIS, cyclic voltammetry and corrosion characterization.
geometryBrief: Gold front panel, D-sub cell connection, rear power/USB, cables and electrochemical cell.
behaviorBrief: Complex impedance, CV and equivalent-circuit fits; separate material limits from modeled pulse response.
inputs: Three-electrode cell configuration, electrode circuit model, frequency sweep or voltage waveform
outputs: Complex impedance spectrum or current–voltage trace with acquisition settings and fit residuals
acceptance: Use an ideal parallel RC dummy cell. At f = 1/(2πRC), recover impedance magnitude R/√2 and phase −45°. For an ideal capacitor under a voltage ramp, check I = C dV/dt.

name: Semiconductor analyzer
model: Keysight B1500A · B1517A HRSMU and B1520A MFCMU
geometryBrief: Rack chassis, touchscreen, modules, triax ports and probe leads.
behaviorBrief: Sweeps, current compliance and circuit model; attach virtual probe station.
inputs: Device terminal map, installed measurement modules, sweep definition and compliance limits
outputs: Terminal-resolved I–V or C–V measurements with compliance and range flags
acceptance: Sweep a resistor through a declared current limit. Match Ohm's law below compliance and flag the limited points. A separate ideal capacitor must yield constant capacitance with bias.
geometryStatus: Documented metric chassis and module GLB; original animated probe fixture
simulationStatus: Independently checked resistor compliance and ideal capacitor C–V
integrationStatus: Dedicated simulator with typed passive fixture import and signed sweep export

name: Source measure unit
geometryBrief: Touchscreen, front terminals, rear ports and test leads.
behaviorBrief: Source voltage/current, compliance, sweep and measurement noise.
inputs: Device terminals, source mode, requested sweep, compliance setting and lead model
outputs: Paired measured voltage and current samples, compliance flags and continuity result
acceptance: Source 1 V into an ideal 1 kΩ load. Read 1 mA when allowed, then set a 0.5 mA limit and require approximately 0.5 V at the load with compliance asserted.

name: Digital oscilloscope
geometryBrief: Display, vertical/timebase knobs, BNC inputs, probes and trigger controls.
behaviorBrief: Render actual solver traces with scales, coupling, trigger and sample rates.
inputs: Timestamped analog trace, sample clock, probe scaling, coupling and trigger definition
outputs: Sampled waveform record with channel units, trigger index and timebase
acceptance: Acquire a known periodic pulse with its edge on a sample instant. Cursor separation must recover the period to one sample and the trigger must align to the specified edge.
geometryStatus: Metric GLB · documented envelope, inferred enclosure details
integrationStatus: Simulator, Cortex CSV import and voltage capture export

name: Analog aesthetic oscilloscope
purpose: Visual reference for a period-inspired functional waveform monitor.
geometryBrief: CRT, graticule, mechanical knobs, BNCs, handle and vents.
behaviorBrief: Original or accurately traced control layout; scientific data from shared measurement engine.
inputs: Shared analog signal, vertical sensitivity, sweep time per division and trigger level
outputs: CRT trace projection and graticule coordinates tied to the source waveform
acceptance: Display a 2 V peak-to-peak, 1 kHz sine at 1 V/div and 0.2 ms/div. The graticule must show two vertical divisions peak-to-peak and five horizontal divisions per cycle.

name: Waveform generator
purpose: Create controlled bench stimulus and test waveforms.
geometryBrief: Display, buttons, knobs and output connectors.
behaviorBrief: Time-series source, amplitude, frequency and trigger; not assumed medical-grade stimulator.
inputs: Waveform parameters, sample clock, trigger time, source impedance and load convention
outputs: Timed source waveform and trigger events at the modeled output port
acceptance: Connect a resistive load matching the source impedance. A specified open-circuit sine amplitude must halve at the load while the generated frequency remains unchanged.

name: Precision LCR meter
purpose: Measure passive test structures and fixture parasitics.
geometryBrief: Screen, input terminals, front controls and fixture.
inputs: Complex test impedance, fixture model, frequency grid and open/short calibration records
outputs: Corrected impedance and selected series or parallel component readings
acceptance: Simulate known stray shunt capacitance and series resistance on a capacitor standard. Apply matching open/short corrections and recover its labeled capacitance across the fixture's valid band.

name: RF network analyzer
purpose: Characterize implant telemetry and inductive coupling hardware.
geometryBrief: Rack front, test ports, cables, antenna or coil fixtures.
behaviorBrief: S-parameters from supplied circuit/EM model; do not infer in-body performance from free-space data.
inputs: Frequency-indexed two-port network or Touchstone data, reference impedances and port map
outputs: Complex S-parameters with frequency, reference impedance and calibration plane
acceptance: Use an ideal matched, lossless through fixture. Require zero reflection and unit transmission magnitude in either direction. A known delay must produce the predicted phase slope.

name: Precision power supply
geometryBrief: Front panel, binding posts, display and leads.
behaviorBrief: Voltage/current limits, load state and power budget.
inputs: Per-channel voltage settings, current limits, connected loads and channel wiring
outputs: Supply operating state and measured voltage, current and power by channel
acceptance: Set 5 V with a 0.1 A limit. An ideal 100 Ω load must draw 50 mA at 5 V and a 10 Ω load must settle at 1 V in current limit.

name: Low-noise preamplifier
purpose: Amplify weak extracellular and bench signals.
geometryBrief: Analog switches, gain knobs, BNCs and rack chassis.
behaviorBrief: Gain/filter response, saturation, noise and coupling.
inputs: Differential input trace, gain, filter configuration, coupling and output range
outputs: Amplified voltage time series with filtering, saturation and noise metadata
acceptance: With noise disabled, drive an in-band sine below clipping and recover the selected gain. Then exceed the configured output range and verify clipping rather than wraparound.

name: Lock-in amplifier
purpose: Extract weak signals at a reference frequency.
geometryBrief: Display, reference inputs, knobs and front connectors.
inputs: Input signal, phase reference, demodulation convention, filter and time constant
outputs: In-phase and quadrature traces, magnitude and phase with settling metadata
acceptance: Inject a reference-locked tone of declared RMS amplitude. In phase it must yield X equal to that amplitude and Y near zero after settling. A quarter-cycle shift must rotate the response to quadrature.
geometryStatus: Metric GLB · specified cabinet, photo-inferred front and rear details
simulationStatus: RMS dual-phase classic RC solver · analytic fixtures verified
integrationStatus: Simulator with uniform voltage CSV handoff, trace and revision exports
related: SR860 reference renderings, source photos and specifications

name: Electrochemical test cell
purpose: Hold implant, reference and counter electrodes in controlled medium.
geometryBrief: Glass chamber, lid, electrode clips, cables, temperature sensor and fixture.
behaviorBrief: Impedance boundary conditions, electrode area and electrolyte properties; no clinical safety conclusion.
inputs: Working, counter and reference port assignments, exposed area, bath geometry and electrolyte conductivity
outputs: Cell boundary-condition record and circuit terminals for the potentiostat
acceptance: In an ideal uniform-slab fixture, compare solution resistance with L/(σA). Doubling conductivity must halve resistance and removing the reference lead must prevent a three-electrode measurement.
